decisions: Copernicus DSM is a surface model, not bare-earth validation
80m bilinear reprojection, nearest would be used for class labels if supplied
80m is sample grid, not guarantee of intrinsic accuracy
5x5 local relief is max-min over 400m nominal neighborhood
roughness is local plane-detrended RMS residual with symmetric 5x5 regression; includes no broad regional trend
Cast shadow uses ray traversal and Earth curvature d^2/(2R), not hillshade
Unknown if search exits context before obstruction; 0 means clear only through 6.4km
No filling or smoothing: no automatically detected reason for mutation
UTM used as local metric grid, local scale accuracy not measured; verify distortion before quantitative interplanetary inference
site centers chosen from tile centers; site identity and bare-ground status unverified
no low-sun annual duration or final interplanetary similarity without independent information
